Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, that's not what happens! Your stuff disappears! Not Mom! Your stuff!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, okay, we gotta figure out what happened.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: A beam came down from that balloon and hit your mom right before she vaporized!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The Mysterious Force that takes away your inventions took Mom away!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Walk it back, Candace. We've gotta figure out what happened!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Guys, is it just me or does that cloud kind of look like your mom?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, she's right! Look! That is Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! I recognize that look of tired disapproval anywhere!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (looking at a tablet) Inexplicably, your mother's vaporized bits have coalesced with the high humidity in the air to form a "cumulo-mom-bus" if you will.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But she looks very unstable. We need to somehow get her back to her solid form before she dissipates and—

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no, no, no, no, no!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Guys, I know what we have to do today! Save Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Buford, Isabella, you go after that balloon. Get whatever device did this so we can try to reverse it and make Mom Mom again. Baljeet, find a way to calculate Mom's stability. We need to know how long we've got before she dissipates entirely. And Ferb, we have to keep Mom together as long as we can. Come on, guys! We can use the rides!

Name: Buford
Dialog: We'll take it down with this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I brought Mom out, I bumped the fan. This is my fault.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, uh, grab the Whack-a-Pest and follow us!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How do I start this thing?! Oh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, you broke it. I consider myself thwarted there. This is not how I wanna—Whoa! A huge cloud with a face! You don't see that every day. Wait, wait. How could I use this for evil? Hmmm...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Agent P, Doofenshmirtz has created some sort of living cloud and we believe he may turn it into a huge storm to wash away everything he dislikes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yes, that's a great idea!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's what I'm gonna do! Thank you, Francis!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Too late! Ha ha! (singsongy) You helped me be evil!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Plummet-pus! 'Cause you're... 'Cause you're plummeting!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Excellent! And I have repurposed my portable particle accelerator science project (which took second place? Hello?!) to track Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher's essence. Even under optimal conditions, I calculated she can only hang together for another eight minutes and forty-seven seconds!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why did I get the big slow heavy one?! Guys, vacuum at three o'clock!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait... Oh, forget it! (He walks into his lab.) All right, back to work. I just can't think of a way to turn a cloud into a storm. Hmmm, maybe I can go online and research it or— Oh, what am I thinking? There's an easier way to do this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hi, Francis, it's your old friend, Heinz Doofenshmirtz, calling to gloat about my brilliant unguessable scheme to scientifically turn a cloud into a storm.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Unguessable? It's basic meteorology! You're going to upset the existing cloud's warm front by hitting it with a cold front.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Hit it with a cold front." Great idea! Thank you, Francis!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, Buford, pop the balloon and win a prize! (under her breath) Miss it and my future mother-in-law is gone forever.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (in Buford's earpiece) What do you see in there?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, I'm no scientist, but dere's a big rectangular upholstered object... I'm gonna say mid-century modern, kinda...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! Couch! I couldn't think of the word! There's also this big metal device labeled "vaporizer-inator". But it's broken.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (on radio) Not to add pressure to what is already a high-pressure system... (giggle) but we have six minutes and forty-one seconds 'til your mom dissipates completely!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Got it! At least we made it through all the wind-based obstacles.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh. Did you say "Wind-Con"? The largest annual international wind-themed convention?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh. I mean, it's, uh, it's totally gotten so commercialized now. It's so lame.

Name: Enthusiast 1
Dialog: What do you think of Wind-Con?

Name: Enthusiast 2
Dialog: It totally blows! So much better than last year's Vacuum-Con. Heh! That sucked!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've gotta find somethin' to block those fans!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can use these billboards to get Mom into that alley and contain her.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Got her boxed up like... something in a box!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's a good thing I had this old Cooler-Off-inator. All right, where'd that cloud go? Oh! There she is! (fires the inator) I'm gonna make it rain, baby!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's going on? What happened to Mom?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am so evil right now! I'm back, baby!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We got the device, but it's broken!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (hands the inator to Baljeet) But you can fix it, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The answer is yes! But we will need to rig a power cable because the battery is fried.

Name: Buford
Dialog: If ya need me, I'll be over here on the thingy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right! (throws Perry) Perry the Platypus, you need to chill out!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (encased) I really asked for that, didn't I? Oh, now what? Some petard hoisting? Oh, okay. Figures.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tell Francis that his evil scheme leaves a lot to be desired.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (over radio) Phineas! Good news, I have the device that turned your mom into the cloud and I am trying to reverse it! But the battery is not working so we are having to run an extension cord from your house. Can you get the Mom Cloud here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not with these bumper cars, they're way too light! We can't even get near her!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps what we need is a big, slow heavy vehicle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Big, slow, and heavy? That's me! (She ties her shoelaces to the handlebars.) If there's one thing I know how to do... (whacks) it's get to Mom! (whacks) Get through to Mom! (keeps whacking)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Go, Candace! (to Ferb) And I thought you were crazy putting tank treads on a Whack-a-Pest!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, if there is ever a time when I need you to listen to me... (whacks some more) ...listen to me now! Mom! Remember what you... wanted for today? Remember? You wanted us all to be together as a family! (groans) For the first day of summer! (ducks) Your favorite memory! You wanted us all to be together at home!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I-I don't know what you did there, Candace, but it's workin'! Let's lead the way, Ferb!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Get the giant cotton candy machine locked down in the front yard! The spinner head should hold her in place!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Time ta go for a spin!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: She has absorbed too much water! She is nearly two tons! We cannot fire the device until she is close to her normal density! Otherwise she could explode!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So how the heck do we get ride of all that water weight?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! Poser is up! Here it goes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Mom! Come back to us!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, I'm fine. I don't remember how I got here, but I'm glad to see you guys. All you guys!

Name: Danny
Dialog: Man, that was like Cleveland '92 all over again!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I love this song! Come on, Lawrence! Family time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can you take our picture please? (hugs Irving, who smiles)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Because we're sayin' it is, sayin' it is
